title: check_supplier_eligibility input
description: At least one of supplier_ids or supplier_names must be supplied; omitting both is MISSING_PARAMETER.

category.description: Product category of the reorder item. POL-002-C03 requires a supplier to be approved for it.

as_of_date.description: Date eligibility is assessed on. Governs suspension effective dates and quotation expiry.

supplier_names.description: Registered names as they appear on a quotation. Matched exactly; a near match is reported, never resolved.

quotation_ids.description: Optional. When given, quotation validity is checked too, producing EXPIRED. Requirement 4.
